**zscore_7d** = (market − avg_prev_7d) / sd_prev_7d — i.e., how many standard deviations today's market price is above or below its average over the prior 7 calendar days. It measures how unusual today's price is vs the past week; |z| ≥ 3 (with ≥5 prior days and price ≥2 in its currency) flags a row as a spike (`is_spike`).

Got it from the column description of `fct_daily_prices`.
